english_text: An employee spent PKR 1,500 on a meal during business travel and submitted the expense 13 days later. Is it reimbursable, and what documentation is required?
roman_urdu_natural: Ek employee ne business travel ke duran khanay par 1,500 rupay kharch kiye aur 13 din baad expense jama karwaya. Kya is ki reimbursement ho sakti hai aur kaun si documentation chahiye?
roman_urdu_codemixed: Business travel mein meal par PKR 1,500 spend huay aur claim 13 din baad submit hua. Kya reimbursement possible hai aur receipt required hai?
